_meta.description: Canonical entity schema definition for CedarFix Lebanese public entities. Every entity JSON must follow this structure.

confidence_levels.high: From official site, published law, or government PDF
confidence_levels.low: News article, third-party, or inferred from context
confidence_levels.blocked: Useful value found but requires live verification before routing use

human_review_triggers: Contact number changed or conflicting across sources
Deadline source is weak (no official SLA published)
Entity responsibility overlaps with another entity
Private vs public actor confusion possible

entity_template.entity_type: public_utility | municipality | law_enforcement | emergency_service | government_ministry | development_authority | environmental_authority

facts.fact_type: legal_responsibility | operational_contact | service_area | complaint_process | deadline_or_sla | emergency_instruction | uncertain_or_needs_human_review
